info.title: Ramplight Auth API
info.description: Registration, login, token refresh, service-to-service tokens and user accounts.

put.summary: Set everything a staff member does (one or more of ADMIN, MANAGER, SERVICE_ADVISOR, MECHANIC)
put.description: Applies from the user's next token (within 15 minutes). 409 last-admin / cannot-remove-own-admin keep the workshop administrable.

put.summary: Set the locations a MANAGER, SERVICE_ADVISOR or MECHANIC works at
put.description: Applies from the user's next token (within 15 minutes).
Send the version you read; 409 if someone changed the settings meanwhile.

get.summary: The workshop's branding (workshop ADMIN)

put.summary: Change colour and 'Powered by Ramplight' (workshop ADMIN)
put.description: Send the version you read; 409 if someone changed the branding meanwhile. Empty colour = Ramplight's colours.

put.summary: Upload the logo, dark-mode logo, icon or cover photo (workshop ADMIN)
put.description: kind = logo or logo-dark (PNG/JPEG, up to 1 MB, kept up to 512 px), icon (PNG/JPEG, up to 1 MB, made square on a transparent background, up to 512 px) or cover (PNG/JPEG, up to 3 MB, kept up to 2000 px). The image is re-encoded; its metadata is removed.

delete.summary: Remove the logo, dark-mode logo, icon or cover photo (workshop ADMIN)

put.description: Send the version you read; 409 if someone changed it meanwhile.

get.summary: One demo request

put.summary: Move a demo request on (status) and keep notes; send the version read
Show me as my initials or a built-in character (removes my photo)
Use my own photo (PNG or JPEG, up to 2 MB)
put.description: Cut to its centre square, kept at 256 px as JPEG; its metadata (e.g. location) is removed.

put.summary: Change a location (ADMIN); send the version you read (409 if stale)
Change a location's tax rates, fees and invoice terms (ADMIN); send the version you read

post.summary: Sign up a new workshop with its first ADMIN, with a setup invite's token (public, rate-limited per IP)
post.description: Send the X-Bayflow-Client header like the web app. The workshop is then at <slug>.<base domain>; sign in there. 400 invite-invalid / invite-expired / invite-used when the link doesn't work.

post.summary: Whether a setup link works, and who it is for (400 invite-* when not)
Ask for a demo (public, rate-limited per IP)
post.description: Send the X-Bayflow-Client header like the web app.

get.summary: List accounts: the team (kind=staff), customers (kind=customer) or all (default)
get.description: Sort by username, email, createdAt or enabled, e.g. sort=createdAt,desc

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The size of the page to be returned

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sorting criteria in the format: property,(asc|desc). Default sort order is ascending. Multiple sort criteria are supported.

post.summary: Create a MANAGER, SERVICE_ADVISOR, MECHANIC or ADMIN account
post.description: MANAGER, SERVICE_ADVISOR and MECHANIC work at locationIds; without them, at the organization's only location (400 locations-required if it has several).

post.summary: Reset a forgotten password (ADMIN: anyone else; MANAGER, SERVICE_ADVISOR: customers)
post.description: Returns a temporary password, shown once. It must be replaced at the next sign-in, stops working after bayflow.auth.temporary-password-ttl (72 hours), and the account is unlocked and signed out everywhere.

post.summary: Client-credentials grant for service-to-service calls (role SYSTEM)

get.summary: All the workshop's announcements, oldest first, with whether each is live, scheduled or ended (workshop ADMIN)

post.summary: Add an announcement (workshop ADMIN; at most 10, 409 too-many-announcements)
Register a customer account in this workshop
Rotate the refresh-token cookie and return a new access token

get.summary: Workshops, newest first (status, test, q: name or address)

post.summary: Create a test workshop (no invite; labelled Test) with its first ADMIN
Suspend a workshop: nobody can sign in at its address; its data is kept
Reactivate a suspended workshop

get.summary: Setup invites, newest first (state, q: email, contact or shop)

post.summary: Invite a workshop owner (e-mails the setup link when e-mail is set up)
post.description: 409 already-invited when the address has an invite that still works.

post.summary: Stop an unused setup link from working
Send a new setup link (the old one stops working) valid for another 7 days
Set a new password with the token from the reset e-mail; signs in
post.description: The link works once, for 60 minutes. Ends every other session. 400 reset-link-invalid when it expired or was used.

post.summary: Forgot password: e-mail a reset link to this address, if it has an account
post.description: Always 202, whether or not the address has an account. 503 when e-mail is not set up; 429 after too many requests from one IP address.

post.summary: Change your own password (also replaces a temporary one after a reset)
post.description: Ends your other sessions; returns a new access token and refresh-token cookie.

post.summary: End the session and clear the refresh-token cookie
Sign in with username or e-mail; returns an access token and sets the refresh-token cookie

get.summary: The organization's locations, with their effective time zone and labour rate
get.description: Customers see the active locations only.

post.summary: Add a location (ADMIN)
Make an archived location active again (ADMIN)
Archive a location (ADMIN): keeps its history, takes no new bookings or staff
post.description: 409 for the last active location or one with upcoming appointments.

post.summary: Queue an e-mail for an organization (SYSTEM)
post.description: Sent right away and retried if the mail server is down. 503 when e-mail is not set up.

post.summary: Unlock a customer locked out after too many failed sign-ins

patch.summary: Enable or disable an account; disabling ends its sessions

get.summary: A customer's online account: status for their page

patch.summary: Disable or enable a customer's sign-in (MANAGER, ADMIN); disabling signs them out

get.summary: Whether an address is free for a new workshop
The workshop at this address, for its sign-in page (404 when there is none)
The logo, dark-mode logo, icon or sign-in cover photo of the workshop at this address (404 when none)
get.description: Cached by the browser: forever with the ?v= of /current, otherwise revalidated with the ETag.

get.summary: A user's photo at this workshop's address (404 unless ?v= is its current version)
get.description: Cached by the browser for good: a new photo has a new address.

get.summary: The signed-in user's workshop and its settings
Demo requests, newest first (status, q: name, email, phone or shop)
The signed-in user
The workshop at an address (SYSTEM)
A workshop's settings, for other Bayflow services (SYSTEM)
An organization's locations and their effective settings (SYSTEM)
Ids of the enabled staff with the given roles at a location (SYSTEM)
One location's effective settings (SYSTEM); 404 if it is not the organization's
Several customers' account status at once (ids=…, at most 100): the customer list
The workshop's account changes, newest first (one account's with userId)
get.description: Staff created, roles and locations changed, accounts enabled, disabled or unlocked, passwords reset, photos removed: who did it, and when.

get.summary: JSON Web Key Set with the public token-signing key

delete.summary: Put a user back to their initials (workshop ADMIN), e.g. for an unsuitable photo
